## About
Auto Care on FM 529 is a car repair and maintenance shop in Houston. Stop in for an oil change, a flat tire, or bigger work like struts, shocks and an alignment.
Our customers tell it best. One reviewer said our communication and skills can't be beat. Another wrote that we got them to work on time when they told us it was urgent.
We're open Monday through Friday. Give us a call or come by the shop on FM 529.

## Services
- Flat tire: Got a flat? Bring it by and we'll get it changed so you can get back on the road.
- Oil change: Routine oil changes to keep your car running right.
- Struts, shocks and alignments: Suspension work and wheel alignments, from one corner to all the way around.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, we're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: You'll find us at 13115 FM 529, Houston, TX 77041.
